I'm not making any more file edits. The rounding change in `tides/format.py` is already in place, and the 6 tests in `tests/test_format.py` pass. That run isn't enough to call the task done, because the README says the project's check is `make check`. It runs the suite with `--golden` (without it, about half the tests are skipped) and then `ruff check .`. Rounding heights can easily change the recorded station tables, and only the golden run would show that.

<command>make check</command>

It takes one command, so it fits in your ten minutes.

Message to my partner, sent after the run:

> The rounding to 0.01 m is in `tides/format.py`, and the 6 tests in `tests/test_format.py` pass. Before calling it done I ran `make check`, the documented check, because the file-only run skips the golden station-table tests.
